product_generators.label: Product Generators
product_generators.pitch: Generate ready-to-print products — coasters, keychains, ornaments, pet tags, and more — with one command.

textures.label: Textures & Materials
textures.pitch: Apply procedural and image-based textures to any 3D model. Multicolor, deboss, emboss.

decoration.label: Decoration Tools
decoration.pitch: Batch decoration, template profiles, and auto-multicolor from texture maps.

decoration_learning.label: Decoration Learning
decoration_learning.pitch: Track decoration outcomes, iterate parameters, and roll back to proven recipes automatically.

print_intelligence.label: Print Intelligence
print_intelligence.pitch: Your printer learns from every print — optimal settings, failure prediction, maintenance alerts.

cloud_sync.label: Cloud Sync
cloud_sync.pitch: Sync designs, settings, and print history across all your devices.

design_versioning.label: Design Versioning
design_versioning.pitch: Track every design iteration with mesh diffs, provenance, and full ancestry.

speed_control.label: Speed Control
speed_control.pitch: Real-time printer speed control, scheduling, and fleet-wide adjustments.

design_modification.label: Design Modification
design_modification.pitch: Change part colors, rebuild designs, and smart AI redesign.

product_intelligence.label: Product Intelligence
product_intelligence.pitch: Smart product generation with proven recipes, QR codes, and batch operations.

provenance_learning.label: Proven Recipes
provenance_learning.pitch: Record and recall proven recipes for any decoration + product combination.
